verdict.rationale: Docs show the API can create accounts, send/receive payments, and issue cards, mirroring several core UI capabilities (wise-docs-1..6), but there's no evidence of full parity — no OpenAPI/spec found (wise-probe-2 all 404), and UI-only features like rate locks, FDIC opt-in, or dispute/support workflows aren't shown as API-accessible. missing for 10: a published complete API reference/OpenAPI spec, explicit parity statement, coverage of rate-lock/insurance/account-management UI features via API, and independent confirmation of full functional overlap.
